items.title: Caesars Agrees to $5.7 Billion Takeover by Tilman Fertitta
items.summary: Billionaire Tilman Fertitta is buying a debt pile with a casino company attached. His firm is assuming $11.9 billion of debt from Caesars while putting up $5.7 billion to acquire it. Expect asset sales as an endgame.

items.title: United CEO Slams ‘Idiotic’ Theory He Used American Bid as Cover for Smaller Deal
items.summary: United is done trying to buy growth. Scott Kirby is now betting that weaker rivals will hand it to him for free.

items.title: Singapore’s YouTrip Launches a Children’s Travel Card Into a Gap Asia’s Fintechs Left Open
items.summary: YouTrip’s move raises a question: When do under-18s stop being an add-on to adult travel and become a customer segment in their own right? The answer may be much earlier than expected.

items.title: Avelo Airlines Looks to Car, Hotel Partnerships After ICE Controversy
items.summary: The ICE partnership hurt Avelo's brand. And the airline's CEO now acknowledges it had a real financial impact too.

items.title: Direct Booking Tug-of-War: Hotels’ Long Bid to Take Back Power
items.summary: Ten years after Hilton, Marriott, and other chains began coaxing travelers to book directly, online travel agencies still control roughly the same slice of the pie. Yet the chains have won the economics: lower commissions, better contract terms, and stronger loyalty programs.

items.title: Accor CEO Bazin to Step Down in 2028, Shareholders Push Back on Pay
items.summary: Accor had a retirement policy. So the news here is CEO Sébastien Bazin saying a “succession search” is underway and that he may leave sooner if the board “finds the right person.” More than 40% of shareholders voted against his pay.

items.title: Expedia x IShowSpeed: Why Brands Are Doubling Down on Creators
items.summary: Expedia's IShowSpeed partnership is another signal that creator marketing has moved from experiment to core strategy among travel brands — though it’s not yet clear how its social media impressions are converting to bookings.
